'''Andon Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] for [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
